name: Cadet Master Sergeant metal chevron on the 2 in OCP square
size_basis: Scale 350.0 photo px per inch: the Vanguard Cadet CMSgt photo (612 px tall) is set to 1.75 in, from the requester's statement (2026-10-12) that it nearly fills the 2 in OCP square leaving about 1/8 in top and bottom; CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-5 gives no inch size. Every grade uses the same scale (the photos share one scale: 381 px chevron width).
provenance: traced from the Vanguard cadet chevron photos (images/ranks/C) at the requester's direction; chrome shading flattened by chroma classification

mounts.rule: metal device on the 2 in dark blue square (7.1.1.2.2, 6.1.10.2.2, 6.1.14.4.2); Airman Basic wears no device and no blue material

dimensions.form: metal chevron centred on a 2x2 square canvas (no cloth: place on rank-ocp-square-blank)
